scope: Phase3, existing development cohorts only; not phase4 or a new algorithm
question: At the same measurement budget, do frozen C3/C4 reduce BOTH false-free time F and false-occupied time O beyond strong simple controls?
known_outcomes: All previous C0-C5, check256/check512 and tuning128 results are known. These checks are reused development diagnostics, never a fresh confirmation test.
targets: Frozen C3 without_time: free30<300,45<900,75 thereafter; occupied30<300,60 thereafter
Frozen C4: same rule, free plateau72

controls.state: All169 free/occupied pairs from BASE_ACTIONS, including fixed controls; no observed-run age
controls.two_stage: Free early[30,45,60], threshold[300,900], plateau[60,75,90]; occupied early[30,45,60], threshold300, plateau[45,60]. Keep early<=plateau in each state:90 schedules. All use observed runs, not true state ages. This includes the previously selected simple45->75 after900/occupied60.
controls.S2: Existing Champati2022 parking adaptation, unchanged solver/count model, nominal budgets[960,1200,1320,1440,1680,1920,2400,2880]. Its original objective is age penalty per decision, not F/O.
controls.pooled: Union of fixed/state/two_stage/S2 controls, excludes C3/C4 targets

selection.data: Original256 Jan-June training,3 common phases; original128 July-September tuning,10 common phases. Both>=7day and>=1day windows: four fitting cells.
selection.rule: For each target and control family find nonnegative mixture weights summing to1. In EACH fitting cell constrain expected control sample count<=target sample count. Minimize t subject to control F<=t*target F and control O<=t*target O in all four cells. LP uses normalized positive counts, no M60 filtering; ties use deterministic HiGHS result. Freeze weights BEFORE replay of check256/check512.
selection.meaning: A mixture randomly chooses a complete constituent schedule once per known window, independently of its future state, then follows it. All policies in a mixture share exposure. Weighted raw metrics are expected values over that policy choice; not exact realized sample equality at every bay and not direct interpolation of runtime pauses.
selection.training_data_fairness: State/two-stage mixtures and C3 use the original256 training cohort plus tuning128. S2 retains its frozen Jan-June model over4218 bays; explicitly disclose the larger training set, do not retrain it on check data.

development_check.cohorts: Previously inspected, disjoint check256 and check512, July-September; both window criteria;10 common phases. No other BayIds, late records, reserved validation or final records.
development_check.frozen_comparison: Evaluate training/tuning-frozen mixtures. Report F/O, observed sample mismatch, and M60 as an additional coverage metric. If a control exceeds the target resource on a check, do not call that a matched-budget superiority.
development_check.equal_budget_envelope: Separately, on EACH check cell solve the same family LP with ONE exact resource equality to that cell's target sample count, optimizing F/O using that cell's outcomes. This is a hindsight, optimistic reference envelope at exactly equal EXPECTED budget, NOT a frozen deployable baseline or independent evidence of generalization. A lower t means the reference can reduce both errors relative to the target. It does not automatically prove a deployable control improves on the target.
development_check.uncertainty: For frozen mixtures only:2000 paired whole-BayId bootstrap draws, seed20261025; all windows and phases of a bay stay together. Show pointwise95% percentile intervals for resource and F/O differences, explicitly exploratory and not simultaneous or selection-adjusted. Do not bootstrap individual episodes/phases as independent bays or claim new-world accuracy from zero counts.
development_check.no_respecification: Keep previous M60 criteria in their old records. This diagnostic focuses on display errors; it does not remove or relax previous phase3 success requirements.

interpretation: Advantage over fixed/state controls supports use of observed history, an already known general idea. Advantage over two-stage controls is required to support the extra C3 stage, but does not prove world novelty. If simpler controls are comparable or dominate at equal budget, document it and do not promote C3/C4 as a newly superior algorithm. No automatic progression to phase4.
artifacts: New versioned code/lock/results/CSV/PNG/SVG; preserve old artifacts and snapshot live roadmap/gate before updates.
sources: S1 Lean Sensing2015 frequency/quality context; S2 Champati etal2022 Markov observation LP; own definitions of F/O in the frozen protocol. The mixture LP here is an evaluation/control construction, not a claimed new algorithm.
